title: The Rivergate of the Coral Triangle
author: Ada Halloran
blurb: Rosalind Okafor, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
